title: feat(plugin-grid): report an aggregate bulk handler's BulkActionResult per row
body:
Fixes #34269

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:批量操作 `execution: 'aggregate'` 的处理器若返回 `{ succeeded, failed }`(`BulkActionResult`),结果面板按行报告:成功数、失败行及其原因、未确认的行;返回值带这两个成员却解析不了的,报「结果无法读取」,不再当全成功。
- 为什么改:以前聚合批量只要不抛错就把整个选择算作成功,部分成功的处理器(HotCRM 批量移动)被误报为全部成功;契约已在 `@objectstack/spec/ui` 声明,但没有读取方。
- 风险与回滚:已有聚合处理器若在返回值顶层用 `succeeded`/`failed` 表示别的东西(例如计数),会从「全成功」变成「无法读取」,已在 changeset 中声明;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useBulkExecutor.ts`(`readAggregateResult` 与聚合分支)、`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`(`runBulkActionAggregate` 现在返回处理器的值)、`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx`(两个新结果形态)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/objectBulkActionDispatch.test.tsx -t "BulkActionResult per row"`,预期 5 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Reader.** On an `execution: 'aggregate'` dispatch only, the grid's bulk executor reads the handler's resolve value against the ids it dispatched (`params._selectedIds`) with `readAggregateResult`, parsing it with `BulkActionResultSchema` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`:
  - neither a `succeeded` nor a `failed` own member (nothing, a summary, a link, an array) keeps today's report: every row covered;
  - one of them present but the value does not parse is one **unreadable** outcome for the selection (`BulkResult.aggregateUnreadable`), never full success;
  - a parsed value reports per row: ids outside the selection are dropped, a duplicate counts once, an id in both lists counts as failed, when one id is in `failed` twice the first entry's message wins, and a selected id in neither list is **not confirmed** (`BulkResult.aggregateUnconfirmed`), never succeeded.
- **Rejection is unchanged**: it stays the one-outcome `aggregateRejection` report. The per-row result sits beside it as two new optional `BulkResult` members, never inside it.
- **Dispatcher.** `ObjectGrid`'s `runBulkActionAggregate` returned `void`, so no resolve value ever reached the executor. It now returns the handler's own value, read one level below the action envelope with `readActionPayload` (the reader every other consumer of `ActionResult.data` uses). Closing the dialog re-reads the grid after an unreadable run or one that left rows unconfirmed, as it already did after a rejection.
- **Dialog.** Failed rows are listed under their record with the handler's `message` (and in the error CSV), with no Retry (an aggregate run has no per-row slice). Unconfirmed rows get a `Not confirmed N` tally and their own list. An unreadable run gets its own one-outcome panel with no per-row count.
- **Strings.** Three new keys in every `@object-ui/i18n` pack: `grid.bulk.resultNotConfirmed`, `grid.bulk.notConfirmedRecords`, `grid.bulk.aggregateUnreadable`; `zh-Hant` regenerated from `zh-Hans`; `resultNotConfirmed` listed as a count tally beside `resultFailed`.
- **Spec prose.** The `[PLANNED — not enforced]` marker and the "until the reader lands" sentences are removed from `BulkActionResultSchema`'s TSDoc and `.describe()`, and the reference page `content/docs/references/ui/bulk-action.mdx` is regenerated (`check:generated --fix`). The prose restates seat ruling 6905490575 option A and adds the card's first-entry-wins rule; no schema shape changes. `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` drops "a handler that cannot cover the whole selection must reject" and says how a per-row answer is reported.
- **Declared behaviour change** (review r2 N2, 6907153374), in the changeset: an existing aggregate handler whose return value carries a top-level `succeeded` or `failed` member in another form (counts, or only one of the two lists) moves from the success report to "unreadable".

## Tests

- `useBulkExecutor.test.ts`, new top-level describe "an aggregate run reads its BulkActionResult per row": one pin per reader rule (moved count + failed rows, outside-selection dropped, duplicate once, both lists then failed, first `failed` entry wins, neither list then not confirmed), four unreadable shapes (counts, `error` instead of `message`, one member only, numeric ids), and a CONTROL over five neither-member values (nothing, null, a summary, a link, an array) asserting today's exact report.
- `objectBulkActionDispatch.test.tsx`, new top-level describe "an aggregate run reports its BulkActionResult per row": through the real `ObjectGrid`, `ActionProvider` and `createServerActionHandler` over the `/actions` success envelope: partial result listed per row with no Retry; not-confirmed row listed by name and kept out of the succeeded list; all-unconfirmed run re-reads the grid once on close; unparseable `{ succeeded: 2, failed: 0 }` shows the unreadable panel and no count; CONTROL: a handler returning nothing keeps "Succeeded 2 / 2".

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** The claim named `useBulkExecutor.ts`, `BulkActionDialog.tsx`, the spec file and reference page, the locale packs, new test files and `.changeset/`. This PR also edits:
  - `ObjectGrid.tsx`: without its one-line `return readActionPayload(res.data)` the reader would only ever see `undefined` in the running console. This is the card's own defect (the resolve value is dropped), so it is fixed here.
  - Two existing test files instead of new ones, because AGENTS.md puts a new pin for a component that already has a shared harness file into that file as a top-level `describe` (ruling record 6583487846).
  - `count-families-11445.test.ts`: the new count key, listed beside `grid.bulk.resultFailed`.
  - `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`: it stated the rule this PR retires.
- **Not changed, stale after this PR:** `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.md`, in the `bulk-action.zod.ts` row, still says `BulkActionResultSchema` is PLANNED with nothing reading it. It is an internal audit ledger and no gate reads it; left for the seat.
- Server audit row (`runResolvedActionAsRest`) and skills teaching (#34268) are out of scope, as the card says.
